messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
At position 7 of the IGEA list, what is the required verification frequency for the Effer truck-mounted hydraulic crane built in 2017?

response.text: Alla posizione 7 dell'elenco IGEA, qual è la frequenza di verifica richiesta per la gru idraulica su autocarro Effer costruita nel 2017?
